subject.title: feat: expose resolved backend model in session_status and agent runtime

question: Should OpenClaw add durable resolved-backend provider/model/fallback telemetry to the core session and runtime contract, or keep this as provider-specific log/trace-only observability?
rationale: The missing behavior is proven, but adding persistent fields and user-visible status output changes a core provider/session contract and needs a maintainer-owned API direction before an implementation PR is safe.

options.title: Add additive core telemetry
options.body: Add generic optional resolved provider/model/fallback fields to the session/status/runtime contract and populate them from provider responses or execution trace where available.

options.title: Keep trace-only observability
options.body: Leave durable session rows unchanged and document that resolved backend attribution remains available only in logs, traces, or provider-specific surfaces.

options.title: Defer to provider plugins
options.body: Require each provider or proxy plugin to expose its own attribution details, accepting that `session_status` stays less consistent across providers.

recommendation.title: Add additive core telemetry
recommendation.body: Add generic optional resolved provider/model/fallback fields to the session/status/runtime contract and populate them from provider responses or execution trace where available.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal points to current ownership of the status, gateway session, transport, and runtime usage paths that would define the contract.
